Booking direct

Why book straight
with us.

No middleman between you and your villa: you message us, get the price for your dates and book — the simple way.

No platform fee

Booking sites add their own service fee on top of the rate. Book here and that part simply is not charged.

One WhatsApp thread

Flexible on dates

Daily, monthly & VIP

How it works

3 easy steps to
your perfect stay.

01

Browse or message us

Look through the villas or just tell us your dates, group size and the beach you like.

02

Get a shortlist

We reply with the villas that fit, their availability and the price for your dates.

03

Book & relax

Confirm on WhatsApp and get your check-in details. We stay reachable throughout your stay.

Who we are

Phuket first.
The simple way to rent a villa.

Thai Villas is a villa rental service for Phuket and the rest of Thailand. We focus on the island's west-coast beaches — from Mai Khao and Bang Tao in the north down to Kata, Nai Harn and Rawai in the south — plus Koh Samui, Pattaya, Bangkok, Krabi, Koh Phangan, Hua Hin and Chiang Mai.

You can rent by the night for a holiday or by the month for a longer season. Either way you deal with real people on WhatsApp, get the price for your dates in writing and pay no booking-site fee on top.

Planning something bigger? We also arrange yacht charters, helicopter transfers, supercars and superbikes, so the whole trip sits in one conversation.
